page.overview:
What is Purify?

Purify is the tenth song off of Metallica's eighth studio album St. Anger. It was written by James Hetfield, Lars Ulrich, Kirk Hammett, and Bob Rock.

The subject matter talks about James Hetfield's tough battle with his past, especially his issues with drinking and addiction. The song is about trying to get rid of sins and discover a "skeleton" or true self. It shows his wish to clean himself up and get rid of bad habits during a hard time for the band, which is also shown in their documentary Some Kind of Monster.

Tear it down Strip the layers off My turpentine Old paint, old looks Cover up the past White heat, white light Super white bones Bones of you and I

Pure if I... Can't you help me? Pure if I... Won't you help me? Purify you and I Purify you and I Pure if I... Can't you help me? Pure if I... Won't you help me? You and I purify
